item.title: Basic Summoner
item.description:
Overview

The Basic Summoner is a straightforward mage designed around letting summoned creatures handle the frontline while you support them with Necromancy and Magery.

It is an accessible starting point for players looking to build a dedicated summoner without relying on complicated mechanics.

Aspect Options

Recommended Aspect options include:

  • Void
  • Death
  • Eldritch

These provide different ways to improve the offensive and defensive capabilities of the build.

Link Options

Chain Links are not a major requirement for this build.

item.title: Standard Gatherer
item.description:
Overview

A straightforward gathering template that combines resource gathering with a basic mage and summoner setup. It can be built around either Lumberjacking or Mining, allowing you to collect resources while still having the tools to deal with creatures you encounter in the field.

The combination of Magery, Meditation, and the Wizard’s Grimoire provides reliable spellcasting, while the Summoner’s Tome gives you summoned creatures to help handle PvM threats without turning the character into a dedicated combat build.
